snippet.title: Moving to France in 2025! Here’s My Top Digital Nomad Picks 🇫🇷
snippet.description:
💌Save for later. Follow along as I take the leap to move to the South of France in 2025 🇫🇷. 

1. Portugal
* Visa: Digital Nomad Visa (also known as the D7 or D8 visa)
* Income Requirement: At least €3,280 per month 
* Length of Stay: Up to 1 year, with the option to renew annually and eventually apply for permanent residency or citizenship after 5 years.

If I wasn’t going to France to learn French I would live in Portugal! 

2. Spain
* Visa: Spanish Digital Nomad Visa
* Income Requirement: of least €2,646 per month, per month (or €28,000 annually) for the main applicant. Additional income is required for dependents.
* Length of Stay: 1 year, with the option to renew for up to 5 years. After 5 years, you may qualify for permanent residency.

3. Greece
* Visa: Greek Digital Nomad Visa
* Income Requirement: €3,500 per month for the main applicant. For dependents, an additional 20% for a spouse and 15% per child is required.
* Length of Stay: 1 year, with the option to renew for an additional year. After this period, you may apply for the Digital Nomad Residence Permit, which can be renewed for up to 5 years.

snippet.description:

Find out about the big changes coming to Spain's Digital Nomad Visa in 2025! If you're a digital nomad looking to live and work in Spain, this video is a must-watch for you! Stay updated on the latest developments and requirements for the digital nomad visa in Spain. Read this first! 👇

💰 NEW INCOME REQUIREMENTS 💰
Spain just raised the minimum income needed to qualify:

✅ €2,763/month for solo applicants

✅ €3,798/month for 2 people

✅ €4,144/month for 3 people

✅ €4,490/month for 4 people

✅ €4,836/month for 5 people

(+€346/month per extra person)

😱 BIGGEST SURPRISE? VISA LENGTH! 😱
Unlike before, your visa will now only be approved for the length of your contract. If your contract is 4 months, that’s how long your visa will last. Not a full year anymore! This is a HUGE change that could impact long-term plans.

🚨 What does this mean for digital nomads?

✔️ You’ll need a long-term, renewable contract to maximize your visa length
✔️ If you’re a freelancer, strong client agreements matter more than ever
✔️ Spain is still one of the cheapest & best places for remote work, but planning is now key!
